critique: The render now has a convincingly warm deep-orange-on-black bokeh direction, good soft circular silhouettes, substantial edge-to-edge coverage, and gentle coherent motion from t1 to t4. It is closer to the preset than prior versions, but the field still reads as a relatively orderly grid of similarly sized, textured brown discs rather than a rich, luminous layered bokeh cloud. Many particles remain too dim because of opacity variation, and the largest circles show visible mottled sprite-center detail instead of smooth defocused light. There are also still broad empty gaps, especially through the central areas.

suggestions.why: Increase the horizontal particle count to break up the orderly sparse spacing and create a fuller bokeh field.
Increase vertical particle density so the central black gaps are populated more consistently at both sampled times.
Reduce opacity randomization so fewer discs fall into near-black brown values and the overall field reads as consistently luminous deep orange.
Slightly reduce maximum particle size while adding density, yielding more layered scale variation and making the sprite texture artifacts on oversized circles less conspicuous.
